verdict.rationale: The README documents installing a single named skill with `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo`, alongside an interactive install and a separate install-all path. The skills are described as independently versioned, which supports picking skills individually. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that selective install works, and documentation of selecting several specific skills at once (the native `yy skills install` path and the plugin appear to install everything; per-skill selection relies on the open `skills` CLI).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle
